overview: The Committee of the Whole held its third preliminary budget meeting for fiscal year 2027 to review department presentations and funding requests. The council kept the budget matter in committee for future deliberations.

items.title: Electrical Department Budget Review
items.summary: Discussed the Electrical Department's focus on citywide lighting improvements, traffic signal updates for ADA compliance, and budget increases caused by utility rate hikes.

items.title: Veterans Services Department Budget Review
items.summary: Reviewed the Veterans Services budget, addressing personnel pay adjustments, the Chapter 115 aid program, and outreach projects such as the American Legion veteran housing conversion.

items.title: City Clerk's Office Budget Review
items.summary: Evaluated the City Clerk's budget, focusing on digital application systems, a proposed $120,000 vault storage expansion, and the strain caused by staffing shortages.

items.title: Building Department Budget Review
items.summary: Discussed the Building Department budget, covering the recruitment of a new commissioner, rising software licensing fees, and code enforcement regarding the leaf blower ordinance.

items.title: Adjournment
items.summary: Adjourned the meeting and kept the budget item in committee.
